name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you carry the Symbol of Life to comfort the wounded. The trial prepares you for the sacred duty of resurrection.
As a dwarf, you face this trial in the heart of Ironforge. It recalls the close bonds among defenders who brave ambushes by hostile Dark Iron clans.

faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a rite of passage for young paladins learning the ways of the Holy Light. After proving charitable and patient, an initiate receives the Symbol of Life and is sent to aid a wounded dwarf in Ironforge.
faq.q: What is The Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is a sacred token entrusted to paladin initiates during their trials. It carries the Holy Light’s power to heal and restore those fallen while defending their people.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: Muiredon Battleforge is a dwarven fighter wounded in a clash with Dark Iron dwarves. A priest tends him in Ironforge while his wife sends promising paladins to hear his tale.

Muiredon Battleforge’s wife, a paladin mentor in Ironforge, gives you the Symbol of Life. After seeing your charity and patience, she sends you to aid her wounded husband and test your power, readiness for combat, and willingness to help.
faq.q: Who gives you the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: Muiredon and his companion Narm were ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves. Muiredon escaped and returned to Ironforge with grave injuries that need spiritual and physical mending.

Narm is Muiredon Battleforge’s best friend and fellow paladin. He accompanied Muiredon into battle against the Dark Iron dwarves, but did not escape the clash, leaving a paladin’s aid needed on his behalf.

sections.body: In Ironforge, paladin initiates face a trial of martial skill and holy power. They have already shown humility, patience, and charity. Now they are entrusted with the Symbol of Life and sent into the city to help those suffering from conflicts beyond its gates.
sections.title: A Trial of Faith and Power

sections.body: Muiredon Battleforge lies badly wounded after a clash with Dark Iron dwarves. A priest tends his immediate injuries as he prepares to tell what became of his expedition and his companion Narm. The initiate must answer that need with the Light’s gift of renewal.
sections.title: A Brother Fallen

summary: In Ironforge, The Tome of Divinity tests paladin initiates in holy power and martial devotion. Entrusted with the Symbol of Life, an initiate is sent to aid Muiredon Battleforge, wounded after a deadly encounter with Dark Iron dwarves.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
